_comment: CKG functional verification ground truth (general, post-remediation). Built on the CLEAN dev graph (src_commit 9978930ba). C1 = keyword->code definition, validated against on-disk go-stablenet source. C2 = keyword->change history, validated against `git log -L:<symbol>:<file>` (symbol-precise history) on dev. Dataset is Go-only (--lang go): Solidity/TS are not parsed into definition symbols (only git-history hunks for .sol), so C1 is Go-only by necessity (reported as a coverage finding). No test/throwaway symbols.
_c2_note: C2 symbols must have a real function/method BODY (not an interface declaration), else `git log -L` yields no symbol-precise history. Each below confirmed to resolve to a concrete body on dev.
